label: Gödel's 1970 theorem Th2: at every world where some individual is…, by Universal-instantiation
meaning: AFP Th2 (Ax3 Th1 God_def NecExist_def). A God-like x has necessary existence, which is positive (Ax3), and being God-like is an essence of x (Th1), so being God-like is exemplified by an existing individual at every accessible world.
